changelog: Word report: a small gap between two tables that follow each other (KPI boxes and the sample table). docx_export.py is reloaded on every report, no restart needed.

previous.changelog: Reports as Word files: the report dialog (amplicon) has a File type choice — PDF or Word (.docx, editable) — and ONT-WGS runs get a 'Word report' button next to 'PDF report'. The Word file is built from the same HTML as the PDF (new backend/docx_export.py): real headings (navigation pane), editable tables with repeated header rows, captions, notes, header/footer with page numbers, and the charts as high-resolution images. Needs python-docx and cairosvg in the backend venv. /report takes format: 'pdf' | 'docx'. Also: heatmap '<.1' cells written as valid XML. main.py changed — uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.
